title: Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance
abstract: arXiv:2610.16015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid deployment of agentic AI has introduced complex challenges for the ethics and governance of AI systems. Agents built on large language models act through tools on behalf of people, and each deployment case brings its own instructions, policies, evidence, and stakeholders, so alignment must be formed case by case. To this end, this work proposes agentic reflective equilibrium (ARE), a computational reflective equilibrium framework that serves as an ethical alignment scaffold in the agent harness. Drawing inspiration from the reflective equilibrium of John Rawls, the scaffold links principles from the system prompt and operator policy, considered judgments, tool evidence, and candidate actions through typed support and attack relations, with provenance encoding the instruction hierarchy. translated_title: 面向智能体AI的计算反思均衡：一种用于治理的罗尔斯式对齐支架
translated_abstract: 智能体AI的快速部署为AI系统的伦理与治理带来了复杂的挑战。基于大语言模型构建的智能体通过工具代表人类行事，而每个部署案例都有其自身的指令、政策、证据和利益相关者，因此对齐必须逐案形成。为此，本工作提出了智能体反思均衡（ARE），这是一种计算反思均衡框架，作为智能体框架（agent harness）中的伦理对齐支架。该支架受约翰·罗尔斯反思均衡思想的启发，通过类型化的支持与攻击关系，将来自系统提示词和运营者政策的原理、经过深思熟虑的判断、工具证据以及候选行动联系起来，并以溯源信息编码指令层级。智能体基于该状态的均衡采取行动，且仅当调用工具或提问的价值超过其成本时才这样做，除非尽职调查……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出受罗尔斯反思均衡启发的计算框架“智能体反思均衡”（ARE），通过类型化的支持与攻击关系将原理、判断、工具证据与候选行动相连接，为智能体AI的逐案伦理对齐与治理提供支架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes agentic reflective equilibrium (ARE), a Rawls-inspired computational reflective equilibrium framework that links principles, considered judgments, tool evidence, and candidate actions through typed support and attack relations, serving as an ethical alignment scaffold for case-by-case agentic AI governance.
